title: Revolutionizing Infrastructure Resilience: AI-Driven Predictive Maintenance and Structural Health Monitoring
content: Rapid urbanization calls for robust infrastructure systems that prevent failures and ensure long-term reliability. This study delves into the transformative potential of AI-driven predictive maintenance and structural health monitoring (SHM), utilizing advanced sensor networks for real-time anomaly detection. These intelligent frameworks empower decision-making and reduce lifecycle costs by integrating machine learning algorithms, data privacy protocols, and robust cybersecurity measures. Through case studies spanning transportation, energy, and smart cities, the paper demonstrates how these technologies enhance operational efficiency and sustainability. By enabling early fault detection and timely interventions, they contribute to building resilient infrastructure systems capable of withstanding increasing urban demands. The research also addresses key challenges such as scalability, interoperability, and adherence to international standards, which are critical for widespread adoption. It further explores future directions, emphasizing the need for interdisciplinary collaboration to optimize these solutions. Ultimately, the study underscores the vital role of innovative technologies in fostering sustainable, adaptive infrastructure management in an ever-evolving urban landscape.
